about.description: TSM is a single-stock perpetual listed on Gate, tracking Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company Limited, margined and cash-settled in USDT. Traders get synthetic price exposure only - no ownership, dividend or voting rights in the underlying. Funding settles every 8h. Up to 100x leverage. Margin is custodied by the exchange rather than self custodied, and access requires exchange onboarding with identity verification.
